title: 五塊錢的郵票
subject: a young man who buys a 1980 monkey-year-looking stamp at a Sunday flea market for five yuan, sure it is worth a fortune, and the old appraiser with a magnifier tells him it is worth exactly five yuan
caption: Mandarin jazz rap, 1990s jazz-hop style. A dusty upright bass loop walking under the verses, muted trumpet phrases between lines, vinyl-crackle piano chord stabs, swung boom-bap drums with a brushed snare. Warm lo-fi tape saturation and soft vinyl hiss, intimate dry vocal. Male mid-range rapper, laid-back conversational flow with deadpan punchlines. 88 BPM, F minor. Dry, self-mocking and good-humoured. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no 808 slides, no EDM synths, no sung pop chorus.
lyrics:
[Intro - upright bass loop, muted trumpet, vinyl crackle]

[Verse 1]
星期天早上的跳蚤市場
一個鐵盒子 一堆舊郵票
一隻紅色的猴子看著我
老闆說五塊 我手在抖

[Pre-Chorus]
我用信封把它包好
一路走得比誰都小心

[Chorus]
五塊錢的郵票
我已經在想要買什麼車
五塊錢的郵票
先別告訴我答案

[Verse 2]
鑑定的老先生拿放大鏡
看了三秒又看了我三秒
他說年輕人 齒孔不對
這張剛好值五塊

[Pre-Chorus]
我說那我賺了什麼
他說你賺了一個早上

[Chorus]
五塊錢的郵票
我把它貼在冰箱上面
五塊錢的郵票
每天早上跟我打招呼

[Outro - trumpet and bass, crackle fades]
